title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs site quickstarts
author: Avery Chen
description:
Motivation: Provide opinionated RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates and minimal tool-calling examples to help developers ship agent-enabled workflows quickly. This PR adds quickstarts for Python and TypeScript that demonstrate: 1) a RAG agent using our embeddings + vector store, 2) structured tool-calling (search, calendar, calculator) with safe sandboxing, and 3) recommended prompt templates and evaluation prompt sets for regression testing.

What changed (summary): added docs quickstart pages, example apps (Python/TS), reference RAG template YAML, unit/e2e tests for examples, and docs site navigation updates. Also included a short troubleshooting FAQ and a small utilities module for building vector stores in CI.

Checklist:
- [x] Quickstart guides (Python + TS) written and smoke-tested locally
- [x] Example code formatted and unit-tested
- [x] Docs site updated (sidebars and redirects)
- [x] Add short onboarding template for internal evals
- [x] CI checks passing (docs preview + examples smoke)

Notes: Kept code examples intentionally minimal to avoid coupling to a particular vector DB; examples default to an in-memory store with clear comments on production options. Follow-up tickets: DCO to expand Databases/Vector DB connectors (ENG-4590).
